hook: A new study claims 92% of AI agent crashes aren't the model's fault, and this dashboard tracks why.
caption:
92% of AI agent crashes aren't the model's fault — this dashboard shows why 🤖

This is a real-time look inside a multi-agent AI system: every retry, re-route and verification gate, mapped live as it runs.

The claim behind it: most failures trace back to the harness (the scaffolding around the model), not the model itself.

Do you think it's usually the model or the setup around it that fails? 👇
